temporal_monsoon_framework.description: Configurable multi-monsoon classification system respecting cross-calendar year transitions

monsoons.name: Musim Barat (Northwest Monsoon)
monsoons.nomenclature_rule: Cross-year notation (e.g., Musim Barat 2015/2016 for Nov 2015 - Feb 2016)
monsoons.oceanographic_signature: Non-upwelling, high SST (28.5 - 29.5 C), low Chl-a (0.15 - 0.22 mg/m3), high waves

monsoons.name: Musim Peralihan I (Transition I)
monsoons.nomenclature_rule: Single-year notation (e.g., Peralihan I 2016 for Mar - Mei 2016)
monsoons.oceanographic_signature: Onset of seasonal upwelling, gradual cooling of coastal waters

monsoons.name: Musim Timur (Southeast Monsoon)
monsoons.nomenclature_rule: Single-year notation (e.g., Musim Timur 2016 for Jun - Agu 2016)
monsoons.oceanographic_signature: Intense Upwelling, SST drop (25.5 - 26.8 C), Chl-a bloom (>0.60 mg/m3)
monsoons.fishery_phase: Puncak Panen (Peak harvest for Cakalang & Pelagic Complex)

monsoons.name: Musim Peralihan II (Transition II)
monsoons.nomenclature_rule: Single-year notation (e.g., Peralihan II 2016 for Sep - Okt 2016)
monsoons.oceanographic_signature: Decay of seasonal upwelling, gradual thermal stratification
